description: a calm young woman with long straight fair blond hair falling down her back and a thin golden circlet, in layered white and gold vestments with golden embroidery and a long skirt, a golden sash at the waist, soft brown shoes, no staff and nothing in the hands but the reins, no halo, no shield and nothing on the back, sitting upright and relaxed deep in the middle of the saddle exactly like the white-robed rider of the reference, the hips over the saddle and not in front of it, astride, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing right, the face, chest and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near leg showing and the far leg hidden behind the horse, the near thigh lying forward along the saddle and the lower leg hanging straight down from the knee, the skirt falling straight down along the horse's side and the shoe straight under the knee, not slanting forward or backward, both upper arms down along the body and both forearms reaching forward, the two hands close together in front of the body above the horse's neck holding the reins, the same size and place as the reference rider, the whole figure from the top of the head to the foot inside the image, nothing under the rider, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look only: the face, fair hair, white and gold vestments and colours; not the pose and not the sun staff or the book

a finished rider of the game in white and gold vestments, which the author accepted: copy exactly how it sits in the middle of the saddle, seen exactly from the side in profile, the near thigh forward along the saddle and the lower leg hanging straight down, one leg showing, and how both hands reach forward together to the reins; not its dark shawl, brown hair, golden sun on the chest or face
the pose of the figure: sitting sideways, the near thigh forward and the lower leg hanging straight down, only the near leg; not its hood or cloak
